prompt: The vet pointed down and told me my cat (to hide) under his chair.
explanation_ru: После глагола в прошедшем времени (told) Present Continuous (is hiding) сдвигается в Past Continuous (was hiding), так как действие происходило в тот момент.

prompt: During the lesson, the teacher shouted that our onions (to burn) in the pan.
explanation_ru: В прямой речи действие происходило прямо во время урока (are burning), поэтому после shouted используется Past Continuous — were burning.

prompt: A sign on the library door says the history books (to be) upstairs.
explanation_ru: Глагол, вводящий косвенную речь (says), стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвиг времён не нужен — остаётся are.

prompt: When he lived in Melbourne, Ravi told me his neighbours (to grow) huge sunflowers.
explanation_ru: Событие относится к прошлому, и после глагола told регулярное действие в Present Simple (grow) переходит в Past Simple (grew).

prompt: Did Marta hear that our Warsaw gym (will / to open) in May?
explanation_ru: Вопрос стоит в прошедшем времени (Did Marta hear), поэтому в придаточном предложении will сдвигается на would.

prompt: The fruit seller looked upset at the Valencia market. He reported that someone (to steal) three boxes of oranges before sunrise.
explanation_ru: Кража произошла раньше момента сообщения (reported), поэтому Past Simple прямой речи (stole) переходит в Past Perfect — had stolen.

prompt: We waited at the Prague stop. A man explained that we (can / not / to catch) the number nine tram after midnight.
explanation_ru: После глагола в прошедшем времени (explained) модальный глагол can't сдвигается в прошедшую форму could not / couldn't.

prompt: In the Seoul studio, the host grew worried. The producer explained that the guest's car (to get) stuck behind a parade.
explanation_ru: Машина застряла раньше, чем продюсер об этом сообщил (explained), поэтому прошедшее время сдвигается в Past Perfect — had got.

prompt: At the Lagos science fair, did Tunde boast that he (to build) the model volcano without any help?
explanation_ru: Модель была собрана до выступления на ярмарке (did Tunde boast), поэтому для предшествующего действия нужен Past Perfect — had built.

prompt: Our Singapore centre has only one floor. Still, Mei heard a huge shop (will / to take) the top floor.
explanation_ru: Глагол heard стоит в прошедшем времени, поэтому будущее время (will take) в косвенной речи меняется на would take.

prompt: Chiara insisted at the Milan meeting that she (to send) the logo an hour earlier and claimed the client (to read) it right then, though the email had actually come back.
explanation_ru: Отправка письма предшествовала встрече (an hour earlier), поэтому используется Past Perfect (had sent), а действие в момент речи (right then) передаётся через Past Continuous (was reading).

prompt: Exhausted at the Doha gate, Tariq assured his wife that he (to print) their boarding passes and that they (can / to relax) until boarding, not realising his passport was still on the kitchen table.
explanation_ru: После assured результат к моменту речи (have printed) сдвигается в Past Perfect (had printed), а модальный глагол can переходит в could.

prompt: When I complained about my freezing bedroom in the Alps, the ski instructor admitted that the heating (to break) down the night before and promised a technician (to fix) it before dark.
explanation_ru: Поломка случилась накануне (the night before), поэтому нужен Past Perfect (had broken), а обещание на будущее после promised передаётся через would fix.

prompt: I helped with a bakery interview in Lyon. Camille looked nervous and claimed she (to work) in a bread shop for two years. She promised she (to start) at five in the morning without complaining. Later, a friend rang and whispered that Camille's job (to be) actually at a petrol station.
explanation_ru: После прошедших глаголов речи Present Perfect (have worked) переходит в Past Perfect (had worked), обещание (will start) — в would start, а Present Simple (is) — в Past Simple (was).

prompt: I emailed an online shop in Krakow about my missing coat. An agent named Jakub replied that the warehouse (to pack) my parcel the day before. He assured me that the driver (to bring) it to my door by Friday. However, the tracking page clearly says my box (to wait) in their warehouse right now.
explanation_ru: После replied и assured действуют правила сдвига (had packed и would bring), а после глагола в настоящем времени (says) сдвига нет — сохраняется Present Continuous (is waiting).

prompt: Our choir gathered in a Quebec hall before the evening concert. Everyone looked pale when the organiser announced that our regular pianist (to feel) too ill to play. Luckily, Celine smiled and explained that she (to find) a replacement an hour earlier. She promised that we (not / to cancel) the show after all.
explanation_ru: Текущее состояние пианиста сдвигается в Past Continuous/Simple (was feeling/felt), предшествующее действие (an hour earlier) — в Past Perfect (had found), а будущее после promised — в would not cancel.

prompt: While watching their children swim in Sydney, Liam leaned over to Hannah with big news. He whispered that people at the front desk (to talk) about a brand-new indoor pool. He added that the club committee (to approve) the budget the week before and promised that builders (to begin) work in autumn. Hannah rolled her eyes and replied that the club did not even have enough money for new lockers.
explanation_ru: Действие в процессе сдвигается в Past Continuous (were talking), более раннее решение (the week before) — в Past Perfect (had approved), а будущее в прошедшем — в would begin.

prompt: Behind the bar of a New Orleans jazz club, Devon grabbed Mateo's arm. He whispered that a mystery pianist (to land) in town an hour earlier. Devon announced that the guest (to give) a secret late show after midnight. Excited, Mateo checked the back door and told Devon someone (to play) piano inside, though it was only the manager's radio.
explanation_ru: Прибытие до разговора (an hour earlier) требует Past Perfect (had landed), будущее событие после announced — would give, а действие в момент проверки — Past Continuous (was playing).

prompt: During a quiet shift at a Budapest spa hotel, Eszter walked into the staff room looking worried. She told Zoltan that the manager (to decide) to close the outdoor warm pool during winter. She also warned him that half the team (to lose) their weekend shifts once the repairs began. Zoltan kept folding towels and calmly pointed out that guests (to book) winter rooms online at that very moment.
explanation_ru: Принятое ранее решение передаётся через Past Perfect (had decided), прогноз на будущее после warned — через would lose, а процесс в тот самый момент — через Past Continuous (were booking).

prompt: Halfway through the Cannes film festival, my phone started buzzing with alerts. A popular blog reported that the organisers (to change) the closing film at the last minute. Another post claimed that a surprise director (to attend) the final screening on Sunday night. However, the official festival website says the closing film (to stay) unchanged, so readers keep refreshing the page.
explanation_ru: После reported и claimed происходит сдвиг времён (had changed и would attend), а после глагола в настоящем времени (says) сдвига нет — остаётся stays.

prompt: Last week a tourist said the seaside café in Lisbon ___ early.
explanation_ru: После глагола в прошедшем времени (said) и указания на прошлую неделю нужен сдвиг в Past Continuous (was closing); оставлять is closing или will close — частая ошибка.

prompt: The pharmacist in Naples ___ out of cold tablets.
explanation_ru: Перед адресатом используется told me (а не said me или told to me), а Present Perfect после глагола в прошедшем времени сдвигается в Past Perfect — had run.

prompt: Carlos looked down at his coffee in Bogota. He mentioned that the night bus ___ after April.
explanation_ru: После глагола mentioned будущее время (will not run) обязательно сдвигается на would not run; оставлять will — типичная ошибка.

prompt: A retired postman stopped me near Inverness. He warned me that thick fog ___ in fast.
explanation_ru: После warned Present Continuous (is rolling) сдвигается в Past Continuous (was rolling); сохранять настоящее время при пересказе прошлого разговора неверно.

prompt: Although nobody at the Auckland hospital had seen an official notice, Aroha told the other nurses that management ___ twenty new staff in spring.
explanation_ru: После told конструкция is going to hire сдвигается в прошедшее время — was going to hire; варианты с will и is нарушают согласование времён.

prompt: Aoife told her friend she has finished her essay, but her page was empty.
answer: Aoife told her friend she had finished her essay, but her page was empty.
accepted_answers: Aoife told her friend she had finished her essay, but her page was empty.
Aoife told her friend that she had finished her essay, but her page was empty.
Aoife told her friend she'd finished her essay, but her page was empty.
Aoife told her friend that she'd finished her essay, but her page was empty.
explanation_ru: После глагола в прошедшем времени (told) нельзя оставлять Present Perfect (has finished) — его нужно сдвинуть в Past Perfect (had finished).

prompt: At lunch in Jakarta, Budi said me the play was not on Friday.
answer: At lunch in Jakarta, Budi told me the play was not on Friday.
accepted_answers: At lunch in Jakarta, Budi told me the play was not on Friday.
At lunch in Jakarta, Budi told me that the play was not on Friday.
At lunch in Jakarta, Budi told me the play wasn't on Friday.
At lunch in Jakarta, Budi told me that the play wasn't on Friday.
At lunch in Jakarta, Budi said to me the play was not on Friday.
At lunch in Jakarta, Budi said to me that the play was not on Friday.
At lunch in Jakarta, Budi said to me the play wasn't on Friday.
At lunch in Jakarta, Budi said to me that the play wasn't on Friday.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не употребляется напрямую с дополнением (ошибка said me): нужно написать told me или said to me.

prompt: Did Linh really tell the other teachers in Vietnam that the science room would get a new telescope?
answer: Did Linh really tell the other teachers in Vietnam that the science room would get a new telescope?
accepted_answers: Did Linh really tell the other teachers in Vietnam that the science room would get a new telescope?
Did Linh really tell the other teachers in Vietnam the science room would get a new telescope?
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: после вопроса в прошедшем времени (Did Linh ... tell) глагол will верно сдвинут в would get.

prompt: Standing by the window at our Toronto office party, Nadia whispered to me that the director will not stay with the company after August.
answer: Standing by the window at our Toronto office party, Nadia whispered to me that the director would not stay with the company after August.
accepted_answers: Standing by the window at our Toronto office party, Nadia whispered to me that the director would not stay with the company after August.
Standing by the window at our Toronto office party, Nadia whispered to me that the director wouldn't stay with the company after August.
Standing by the window at our Toronto office party, Nadia whispered to me the director would not stay with the company after August.
Standing by the window at our Toronto office party, Nadia whispered to me the director wouldn't stay with the company after August.
explanation_ru: После глагола whispered в прошедшем времени нельзя оставлять will not — требуется сдвиг в would not / wouldn't.

prompt: In a Cairo block of flats, Omar heard a strange rumour about the roof garden. Someone had stolen a neighbour's green parrot. Which sentence reports this accurately?
options: Omar told Salma that someone has stolen a parrot from the roof garden.
Omar told Salma that someone had stolen a parrot from the roof garden.
Omar said Salma that someone had stolen a parrot from the roof garden.
Omar told Salma that someone would steal a parrot from the roof garden.
explanation_ru: Для передачи предшествующей кражи после told нужен Past Perfect (had stolen); варианты с has stolen, said Salma и would steal содержат грамматические или смысловые ошибки.

prompt: Over lunch at a small museum in Crete, Nikos said to Eleni, "A local diver found a hidden room full of old gold cups under the chapel, and archaeologists can open it soon." Later, Eleni told her sister about their conversation. Which sentence is correct?
options: Eleni said her sister that a diver had found a hidden room and archaeologists could open it soon.
Eleni told her sister that a diver found a hidden room and archaeologists can open it soon.
Eleni told her sister that a diver has found a hidden room and archaeologists would open it soon.
Eleni told her sister that a diver had found a hidden room and archaeologists could open it soon.
explanation_ru: После told глагол found сдвигается в Past Perfect (had found), а can переходит в could; в других вариантах допущены ошибка said her sister или неверный сдвиг времён.

prompt: At a Barcelona party, Sofia said, "A local band is playing on the roof." → Sofia told me …
answer: Sofia told me that a local band was playing on the roof.
accepted_answers: Sofia told me that a local band was playing on the roof.
Sofia told me a local band was playing on the roof.
explanation_ru: При переводе в косвенную речь после told me время Present Continuous (is playing) сдвигается в Past Continuous (was playing).

prompt: Inside a Berlin co-working office, Lukas said, "The company will not keep our chat app." → Lukas warned us …
answer: Lukas warned us that the company would not keep our chat app.
accepted_answers: Lukas warned us that the company would not keep our chat app.
Lukas warned us the company would not keep our chat app.
Lukas warned us that the company wouldn't keep our chat app.
Lukas warned us the company wouldn't keep our chat app.
explanation_ru: После глагола в прошедшем времени (warned) форма will not keep сдвигается в would not keep / wouldn't keep.
